title: OMBR project manifest
description: Prototype syntax seed for an OMBR 0.1 automation project, mechanical reference catalogs and mating profiles, electronic interface contract, endpoint electrical profile, timeline, program, safety policy, and digital-twin manifest; it is not a claimable OMBR profile schema. The example.invalid identifier is deliberately non-resolving until project governance assigns a permanent specification URI.

x.description: Optional application-specific semantic label for the positive X axis; not a universal vehicle direction.

y.description: Optional application-specific semantic label for the positive Y axis.

z.description: Optional application-specific semantic label for the positive Z axis; gravity belongs to a named world frame.

networkEndpointUri.description: A network endpoint with no URI userinfo. Authentication uses a logical credential slot whose secret binding is outside the project.

quaternion.description: Unit quaternion ordered x, y, z, w.

sourceSnapshotDigest.description: Digest of the exact normalized source snapshot or release manifest used for a derived artifact.

precision.description: Declared repeatability or precision expressed in the capability unit.

uncertainty.description: Representative measurement uncertainty expressed in the capability unit.

componentInstance.description: A design placement. instanceId is an experimental deployment binding and does not make runtime state part of the design source.

secretSlots.description: Logical secret names only; values and owner-store locators are external activation bindings.

credentialSlot.description: Logical credential name resolved from an owner-protected store outside this project.
